snippet.title: THORNSPELL | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist THORNSPELL on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4514920/THORNSPELL/?utm_source=yt&utm_medium=t&utm_campaign=ng

Embody a magical florist by placing plants strategically in your garden, and watering them to score points. THORNSPELL is a garden-building roguelike where you will create and unleash chains of magical effects, dispelling the corruption spreading through your home.

Wishlist it on Steam and follow for updates on the upcoming playtest we are preparing!
